test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word 'illuminate' from the given sentence.

The toughest and most typical question in the examination was to elucidate a particular theory related to friction in physics.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Elucidate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Illuminate"** means to light something up or to make something clear and understandable. (प्रकाशित करना या स्पष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher used examples to illuminate the concept of gravity for the students.
 
 
 
• **"Elucidate"** is a synonym of "Illuminate," and it means to explain something clearly or make it easier to understand. (व्याख्या करना या स्पष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The professor took extra time to elucidate the complex theory to the class.
 
 
 
• Thus, "Elucidate" closely relates to "Illuminate" in meaning, as both refer to making something clear or understandable.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Elucidate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Typical** (सामान्य): Something that is characteristic of a particular person, thing, or group.

 
 
• **Example:** It's typical of him to arrive late to meetings.
 
 
 
• **Particular** (विशिष्ट): Refers to a specific or distinct thing.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a particular interest in ancient history.
 
 
 
• **Theory** (सिद्धांत): A system of ideas intended to explain something.
 
 
• **Example:** Einstein's theory of relativity revolutionized physics.
